Ready to play 2048?

Join matching tiles and see if you can reach 2048.

Go back and choose another game.

How to play

Slide the whole board to combine matching numbers. Keep building until you reach 2048.

  • ← ↑ ↓ → to slide
  • You can also use WASD to move the tiles.

A helpful tip

Keep your largest tile in a corner, then build matching tiles around it.

There is no timer, so think through each move. Use Undo if you want to reverse your last slide.

Use the arrow keys or WASD, or swipe on a touchscreen. Undo reverses your last move.
